idea-plugin.name: Markmap Jet
idea-plugin.description:
Transform your Markdown documents into interactive mind maps!

Markmap Jet brings visual thinking to your Markdown workflow. See your document structure as an interactive mind map that updates as you type.

✨ Key Features

  • 🧠 Interactive Mind Map Visualization - Transform Markdown structure into beautiful mind maps
  • 🎨 Theme Integration - Automatically follows your IDE's light/dark theme
  • ⚡ Real-time Updates - See changes instantly as you type
  • 🔍 Zoom & Pan Controls - Navigate large mind maps with ease
  • 📱 Flexible View Modes - Editor only, Split view, or Preview only
  • 🎯 Center & Fit - Quickly navigate and focus your mind map
  • 🖱️ Interactive Nodes - Click to expand/collapse branches
  • 📦 Offline Preview - Render diagrams and formulas without a CDN
  • 📤 Export - Save diagrams as SVG or standalone HTML
  • 🔗 Editor Navigation - Follow the caret and double-click nodes to find their source
  • ⚙️ Customization - Configure default options and custom CSS

🚀 How to Use

  1. Open any Markdown (.md) file
  2. Use the toolbar buttons to switch between view modes
  3. Your Markdown headings become mind map nodes automatically
  4. Use zoom controls for better navigation
  5. Click nodes to expand/collapse sections

💡 Perfect For

  • Documentation writers and technical authors
  • Students organizing study notes
  • Project managers planning and structuring content
  • Anyone who thinks visually!

Powered by the excellent Markmap library for beautiful, interactive mind maps.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.0.7

  • Set the default wrap width to 350 px and enlarge note markers
  • Export SVG, PNG, and HTML from a single menu
  • Fix folding controls for preview selection and indented list items
  • Migrate to Markmap 1.x with offline MathJax rendering
  • Choose the visible depth from the Level menu
  • Use the new Markmap frontmatter options and note rendering

Version 1.0.6

  • Zoom the mind map with two-finger scrolling, with improved sensitivity
  • Reduce momentum zoom when supported by the embedded browser
  • Update markmap-view to 0.18.13

Version 1.0.5

  • Forward native macOS trackpad pinch gestures to the preview, preserving the zoom anchor
  • Apply two-finger pan events immediately and interrupt competing viewport animations
  • Keep the icon-only Center View action with a clearer center-and-fit tooltip

Version 1.0.4

  • Support IntelliJ Platform 2025.3 and later with Java 21 and Kotlin 2.2 compatibility
  • Use compatible file navigation and support both bundled and standalone JCEF

Version 1.0.3

  • Coalesce rapid edits and discard outdated preview updates
  • Reduce redundant cursor highlighting and viewport movement
  • Parse Markdown once per update while preserving mixed lists, code blocks, and source line mapping

Version 1.0.2

  • Require IntelliJ Platform 2026.3 or later
  • Preserve list items alongside code blocks under the same heading
  • Update file saving and file opening API calls
  • Update IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3 build tooling and JCEF dependencies

Version 1.0.1

  • Updated the Markmap Jet plugin icon

🎉 Version 1.0.0 - Initial Release

  • ✨ Interactive mind map preview for Markdown files
  • 🎨 Theme-aware UI with automatic light/dark mode switching
  • 📱 Three flexible view modes: Editor, Split, Preview
  • 🔍 Zoom in/out and center controls for easy navigation
  • ⚡ Real-time preview updates as you type
  • 🖱️ Click-to-expand/collapse node functionality
  • 🎯 Smooth animations and transitions
